about: Identity files as the Rust client writes them (shadenet 0.7.1): `plain` by `shadenet init --offline`, `locked` by `shadenet identity-lock` on a copy (scrypt logN 17), `lockedLowCost` by shadenet::identity::serialize at logN 10 so debug-build tests stay fast; `overLimit` is `lockedLowCost` with scrypt logN 20, r 32, p 16, which both readers must refuse before running scrypt. A test identity: never stake this leaf. Read by crates/shadenet/src/identity.rs and packages/node/lib/identity-file.selftest.mjs.
